title: Palestine Stories
premise: A dark comedy set in Haifa port during the late 1940s. Reemi, a young local Palestinian woman, watches as her world changes around her. bibi, a scheming newcomer, arrives at the port with grand plans. Their encounters reveal the absurdity and tragedy of the era through sharp humor and animated storytelling.
visual_style: 2D animated cartoon, thick black outlines, flat color shading, large expressive eyes, bold simple shapes, vibrant colors
setting: Haifa port and surrounding areas, Palestine, 1948
episode_plan: EP1: Opening - Reemi and bibi's first encounter at Haifa port. She is suspicious of him from the start.
EP2: The Key - bibi tries to claim ownership of a building using the key he found. Reemi investigates.
EP3: The Market - Tensions rise at the port market. Reemi rallies the local vendors against bibi's schemes.
EP4: The Rooftop - A confrontation on the rooftop overlooking the port. Truths are revealed.
EP5: The Port - The final showdown at the port. Reemi must decide what she's willing to fight for.
